subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@retailbank.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@retailbank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Jordan / Priya 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + proposed POC plan so we have clear success criteria, ownership, and next steps. TL;DR: we recommend a 6-week evaluation with a 2-week quick verification followed by a 4-week feature evaluation; kickoff target week of Jun 21.

Demo recap (what we showed)
- Redwood hosted API for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and end-to-end latency profile
- Prefix caching and batching examples (how we optimize cost for your short query distributions)
- Admin console: token-level cost views, trace for failing requests, and rollout controls

Proposed POC plan (outline)
1) Success criteria (mutually agreed)
   - Functional: 90% intent-match on 500 sample customer queries (Priya to provide labeled sample set)
   - Latency: 95th percentile <= 350ms for single-turn queries under expected load (TBD exact QPS)
   - Cost: projected token cost <= $0.004 per query on average for evaluation workload (we will provide model/config options)
2) Evaluation plan
   - Week 0 (kickoff, 1 day): environment & data access, success criteria finalization, contact list
   - Weeks 1-2 (smoke test): run 500 labeled queries, verify functional baseline, iterate on prompts
   - Weeks 3-6 (feature evaluation): integrate live dataset slices, evaluate edge cases, resilience testing
3) Ownership
   - RetailBank: Jordan (product lead), Priya (data lead), Alex (security point)
   - Redwood: Camila (AE / POC lead), Dylan (Solutions Eng), Neha (Customer Success / onboarding)
4) Timeline & logistics
   - Target kickoff: week of Jun 21 (we propose Jun 22 for a 60-min kickoff)
   - Data: Priya to provide sample labeled set and S3 bucket with read-only creds OR allow us to use anonymized export (we can accept either)
   - Access: for quick evaluation we can use Redwood hosted API under a scoped data policy; for private testing we can spin up Dedicated or VPC in later stage

Attached: retailbank-poc-outline.pdf (detailed steps) and redwood-poc-sla.xlsx (sample SLAs / roles). Link to shared folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5E-redwood-retailbank-poc

Next steps
- Jordan/Priya: confirm kickoff date (we're estimating 60-90 minutes) and provide sample query set by Jun 18
- Redwood: prepare test environment + short pre-populated dataset, send calendar invite once date confirmed

Thanks  happy to adjust based on your timeline.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

---

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@retailbank.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@retailbank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Camila  thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side before we lock the kickoff: 

1) Data access: we prefer not to move PII externally. Priya can we do an anonymized export? If not, what are the minimum network requirements for a VPC/private eval?
2) Latency objective: 95th <= 350ms looks good, can you confirm what hardware/profile that corresponds to (eg g4dn vs a100) so we can align on expected QPS?
3) Success metric: for intent-match we usually use weighted F1 across five buckets we'll send the labeled set and rubric.

We can provide the labeled set by Jun 18. Jun 22 works for a kickoff on our side (60 min).

Also, please share SOC2 + data handling docs (Priya/ Alex will need them).

Thanks,
Jordan\Product Lead, Customer Experience
RetailBank

Jordan thanks for the questions, answered inline below.

1) Data access: totally understand the PII concern. For the smoke test we can accept an anonymized export (preferred). If RetailBank needs the endpoint to talk to your VPC, we can stand up a Private deployment (VPC peering / private endpoint) within 2-3 business days given approvals. For kickoff we recommend anonymized export to keep the bar low; we'll validate feature parity for private later.

2) Latency objective: the 95th <= 350ms target is achievable on our hosted API using our medium profile (equivalent to 1xA10 / optimized quantized path) for the single-turn queries we saw in the demo. If you plan to scale to higher QPS we can recommend dedicated capacity (1xA100 equiv) and provide updated benchmarks. Dylan will add a short hardware note in the kickoff deck.

3) Success metric: great once you send the labeled set we will run the weighted F1 and return results in our dashboard + a small eval notebook for reproducibility.

SOC2 + security docs: attaching our security packet link and SOC2 excerpt in the shared folder (Drive link above). Alex, please review and let us know if you need anything additional (certs, penetration test reports).

Proposed kickoff: Jun 22, 11:00am PT (60 min). I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Camila

Team  quick internal note before kickoff:
- Camila: thanks for driving. Make sure we have a lightweight eval notebook that the customer can run themselves (good for reproducibility and sales ops).
- Dylan: please prepare the hardware perf slide (g4dn / a10 / a100 comparisons + expected cost buckets) and a short checklist for data ingestion (S3 presigned + minimal schema).
- Neha: please prepare the onboarding playbook and one-pager for success criteria tracking; we'll offer weekly checkpoints during weeks 3-6.

If the kickoff goes well we can consider a modest POC pricing credit  happy to discuss after the first smoke test results.
